payload.because: In splen on 2026-09-14, both peers had written back 3 and 28 minutes before a sibling's push, so the ping had nobody to name. Finishing, committing and leaving the push to a sibling is the normal flow, and it is exactly when a live window needs to hear its work shipped. Registry liveness already filters out dead sessions, so the only extra reach is to idle windows that can still act on the news.
payload.chose: The push ping names any LIVE session a carried record knows, open or already written back. Liveness comes from the host registry plus kill(pid,0), not from the record's open set. Amends SPEC §Acceptance criteria, which says the ping is silent when the other record has no open session.
payload.over: Keeping the ping open-sessions-only, and adding a Sofar-Session trailer so only the sessions that authored the commits get named (commit-attribution D17 already rejected that trailer).

payload.text: splen repair, applied 2026-09-14 at the user's request: `git config --unset core.hooksPath` in /Users/jins/IO/splen. The config was local-scope only, and the linked worktrees splen-digest and splen-products share it. `git hook run prepare-commit-msg` now stamps `Sofar-Initiative: database-architecture-audit`. doctor will keep warning "last 20 commits carry no attribution" until 20 new commits carry the trailer, which is expected. The splen commits from 2026-09-12 to 09-14 stay unattributed, because git history can't be rewritten. Not done: init.ts installGitHook has the same dangling-path blind spot. With a missing absolute hooksPath it skips and tells the user to add the line to a directory that doesn't exist.
